doc.title: Eddie Alley interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002

chapter: Metropolitan Life and the Alley band
title: Singers and dancing together
summary: He had a girl singer, sang a little himself early on, and his music let couples dance close.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: Did you have singers in the band?

And I used to sing in my early days. I can’t even talk now. You wouldn’t believe it now. But I sang a little bit myself. But I had to, I hired a girl singer. And I had a nice — we played, the people danced together.
Yeah. You mean they actually touched each other.
